using JSON3
function sh(cmd)
    try
        strip(read(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -c $cmd`); stderr = stdout), String))
    catch e
        "ERR " * first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n"))
    end
end
res = Dict{String,Any}()
res["julia"] = string(VERSION)
res["host"] = sh("hostname")
res["nproc"] = sh("nproc")
res["slurm_cpus_on_node"] = get(ENV, "SLURM_CPUS_ON_NODE", "")
res["slurm_cpus_per_task"] = get(ENV, "SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", "")
res["scontrol_job"] = sh("scontrol show job \$SLURM_JOB_ID 2>&1 | grep -E 'TimeLimit|NumCPUs|CPUs/Task|AllocTRES' | head -4")
res["mem"] = sh("free -g | sed -n 2p")
res["cgroup_cpu_max"] = sh("cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max 2>/dev/null; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpuset.cpus.effective 2>/dev/null")
res["juliaup"] = sh("juliaup status 2>&1 | head -8")
res["julia_1_10_installed"] = sh("ls \$HOME/.julia/juliaup 2>/dev/null; ls \$WORK/.julia/juliaup 2>/dev/null")
res["git"] = sh("git --version 2>&1; python3 --version 2>&1; which xargs zip unzip 2>&1")
res["clone_test"] = sh("cd \$(mktemp -d) && timeout 60 git clone --depth 1 -q https://github.com/JuliaLang/Pkg.jl.git x 2>&1 | head -2; ls x 2>/dev/null | head -3")
res["julia_tarball_mirror"] = sh("curl -sIL -m 30 https://github.com/luciano-drozda/julia-tar/releases/download/julia-1.10.11/julia-1.10.11-linux-x86_64.tar.gz 2>&1 | grep -E '^HTTP|content-length' | tail -3")
res["work_free"] = sh("df -h \$WORK | tail -1")
d = mktempdir()
write(joinpath(d, "w.jl"), "function f(); s = 0.0; for i in 1:200_000_000; s += sin(i * 1e-9); end; s; end\nf(); t = time(); f(); println(time() - t)\n")
jl = joinpath(Sys.BINDIR, "julia")
np = something(tryparse(Int, res["nproc"]), 1)
scal = Dict{String,Any}()
for k in unique(filter(x -> x <= max(np, 1), [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32]))
    tstart = time()
    out = sh("cd $d; for i in \$(seq 1 $k); do $jl --startup-file=no w.jl > o_\$i.txt 2> e_\$i.txt & done; wait; cat o_*.txt | tr '\\n' ' '; echo; head -c 200 e_1.txt; rm -f o_*.txt e_*.txt")
    first_line = strip(first(split(out, "\n")))
    times = [parse(Float64, x) for x in split(first_line) if tryparse(Float64, x) !== nothing]
    scal[string(k)] = Dict("wall_s" => time() - tstart, "loop_s_min" => isempty(times) ? nothing : minimum(times), "loop_s_max" => isempty(times) ? nothing : maximum(times), "n_ok" => length(times), "stderr" => strip(join(split(out, "\n")[2:end], " ")))
end
res["scaling"] = scal
println(JSON3.write(res))
